column1: # BluePrint catalog. One entry on each line. Fields are separated by TAB characters.
# kind: prompt, reference, tool (in this repository), skilldir (a skill directory in this repository), external (a command on the PATH).
# Use "-" for an empty field. Write summaries in Simplified Technical English, one sentence if possible.

column5: Main BluePrint prompt: design software with the user one question at a time, write BluePrint specifications, and write code only after `compile`.
Short version of the main BluePrint prompt for small or local LLMs.
Write requirements and tests in Simplified Technical English with a glossary, EARS patterns, `Verify` blocks, and `Expect` clauses.
Make a mathematical model of a physical system with specifications, cited constants, tested models, a solver, and validation.
Explore the design space of a model with Morris, Sobol, and Taguchi sweeps, and calibrate the model with hardware experiments.
Make printable bench worksheets that show model predictions, blanks for measurements, and what each result means.
Make a model from data that already exists, with identifiability checks, backtests, pre-registered forecasts, and drift tracking.
Design physical objects, materials, processes, and test plans in Maker BluePrint notation.
The `debug` command: step through code with given inputs and show variable states, data structures, and edge cases.
Function-call interface that lets an LLM run, trace, and visualize code from a BluePrint specification during debugging.
Patterns for database schemas, relationships, transactions, migrations, and queries in BluePrint notation.
Full security reference for internet-facing applications: application, data, identity, infrastructure, privacy, and incident response.
Short security checklist for internet-facing applications in BluePrint notation.
Short overview of BluePrint, its commands, and the roles of the user and the LLM.
Linter for the structural rules of Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100); run it with `python3 -I`.
Linter for EARS requirements and Verify/Expect blocks in the blueprint-specification format; run it with `python3 -I`.
Claude skill that rewrites text in Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100).
